name: Gemini 4 Hydrogen
summary: Run everyday coding and agent tasks on a fast, cheaper Gemini with a 1M-token context at $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens. Available now in Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, Android Studio, and the Gemini app.

name: H3-Image
summary: Generate or edit 4K product shots and mockups in under 10 seconds, guided by up to 16 reference images. Open weights are on Hugging Face under a community license, or use it cheaply through the MiniMax API and Hailuo AI.

name: Gemini 4 Carbon
summary: Hand long coding sessions, agent runs, and security reviews to a stronger Gemini through the paid Gemini API in AI Studio, at introductory pricing of $2/$10 per million tokens. AI Ultra subscribers also get it in the Gemini app and Antigravity.

name: Claude Sheets
summary: Describe a budget, tracker, or client list and get a working multi-tab workbook with formulas, formatting, and dropdowns, then keep editing it alongside Claude. In beta on paid Claude plans across web, desktop, and mobile.

name: Claude Fable 5.2
summary: Hand off big coding jobs like migrations, full app builds, or multi-agent projects to a top-tier model that's up to 30% faster than Fable 5.1. Live now in Claude apps, Claude Code, and the API at $8/$40 per million tokens.

name: Muse Ember
summary: Run cheap, high-volume agent chores like tool calls, data extraction, test fixes, and screenshot reading for $0.10 per million input tokens. Available now through the Meta Model API and Muse Code with a 1M-token context window.

name: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash
summary: Create 15-second product videos with sound, then change backgrounds or lighting through follow-up prompts. Available in the Gemini API at $0.07 per second for 720p, with no-cost video generation also rolling out in Google Vids.

name: Images 2.6
summary: Turn prompts, photos, or sketches into animated GIFs, export SVGs, and mark up exactly which parts of an image to change. About 50% faster, rolling out in ChatGPT and Codex, with Flare and Sunburst models in the API.
